Name: Slime Hutch Winery Interior
Author: KaraSDV
Description:
[size=2]Some mods, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1993]Elle's Seasonal Buildings[/url]﻿, will replace the Slime Hutch exterior with a winery/brewery. This mod creates an interior to go with the exterior change.

If you have any suggestions for the mod please make a post and I will look into it.

[b]WineryType[/b]
- Upgradable
- Finished

The winery can be upgraded with the farmhouse. At the second upgrade the upstairs will be unlocked. At the third the cellar will be available and casks can be placed in the winery. If the player chooses the "Finished" option everything will be available regardless of farmhouse upgrade status.

[b]UpstairsType[/b]
- Empty 
- Furnished

[b]SlimeType
[/b]- None
- GroundFloor
- Downstairs

You can use parts of the building as a normal slime hutch. The config will place the water spots in the stone part of the ground floor or in the down stairs. To make the water spots work you will have to use aedenthorn's mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13778]Slime Hutch Water Spots[/url].

[b]Change Types
[/b]If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is installed you can switch layout and options in title menu.
If not it can be edited in ﻿config.json file in any text editor.

[b]How to Install:
[/b][/size] ﻿0. If you have items placed inside a slime hutch please remove them before installing the mod.[size=2][list=1]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of Content Patcher and SMAPI.[/size]
[*]Download the mod and unzip into "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder.
[*]Run game using SMAPI.
[/list][b]How to Uninstall[/b]
﻿0. If you have items placed inside a slime hutch please remove them before uninstalling the mod.
[list=1]
[*]Delete SlimeHutchWinery folder form "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder.
[/list][/size][size=2]
[/size]
